item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R02-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R02-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R02-E015","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R02-E016","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Egyptian law recognizes legal capacity for persons with disabilities and provides legal-access measures including judicial assistance, fee exemptions, accessible court buildings, and sign-language interpreters and experts in proceedings.","notes":["The excerpt does not support the claim that an administrative court ordered social-security or stipend increases in individual cases.","The narrowed summary retains only formal legal and court-access measures stated in the excerpt."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0024-R02-E017","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Egyptian laws affirm liberty and personal security, while criminal-law provisions punish unauthorized recording, transmission, or publication of private conversations or images, including imprisonment and confiscation; exploitation of public office in such acts is also punishable by imprisonment.","notes":["The excerpt supports liberty, personal security, privacy restrictions, imprisonment, confiscation, and public-official penalties, but it does not support a general claim that the laws protect freedom of expression.","The expression claim was removed without adding facts."]}]}
